response.sql: SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc, AVG(GOT) - (SELECT AVG(GOT) FROM Laboratory) AS got_diff FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID ORDER BY (got_diff IS NULL), got_diff DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average GOT is the average over all non-null GOT rows in Laboratory (each test record weighted equally), not the average of per-patient averages.
A patient with no non-null GOT values gets a NULL average and a NULL difference, and is sorted last.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average GOT is the mean of the per-patient average GOT values, so each patient counts equally.
alternatives.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) SELECT ID, avg_got, avg_rbc, avg_got - (SELECT AVG(avg_got) FROM p) AS got_diff FROM p ORDER BY (got_diff IS NULL), got_diff DESC LIMIT 10
